rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a salad dish, including salad used as a sandwich filling; use 沙律菜 when you specifically mean the raw greens or vegetables.

example.english: I want a chicken salad sandwich.
example.traditional: 我想要個雞肉沙律三文治。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 go3 gai1 juk6 saa1 leot6 saam1 man4 zi6

rows.note: Use this when “salad” refers specifically to salad greens or raw salad vegetables as an ingredient rather than to the prepared dish.

example.english: I bought some salad greens; I’ll make a salad tonight.
example.traditional: 我買咗啲沙律菜，今晚整沙律。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 saa1 leot6 coi3 gam1 maan5 zing2 saa1 leot6
